Name: CraftCook Tracker
Author: Cactusan29
Description:
[size=5][b]What's New (v1.2.0)[/b]
[/size]- Fix bug of not properly counting inventories of 'any' type (e.g. sunfish should be counted into "fish (any)")
- Add Frech translation (thanks [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url])

[size=5][b]Alternative Download[/b][/size][size=2]
[url=https://github.com/linfanqian/CraftCookTracker/releases]Download from GitHub[/url] (CraftCookTracker-[version].zip)
[url=https://github.com/linfanqian/CraftCookTracker/tree/main]Source code[/url]
[/size]
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run Stardew Valley with SMAPI
[/list][b][size=5]How to Use
[/size][/b]Hover on a crafting or cooking recipe from the workbench/stove, you will find how many products you have made so far under the description.

Press [b]R[/b] to find what recipes you haven't crafted/cooked, along with the checklist of required materials. Press [b]←[/b] or [b]→[/b] to switch between the crafting and cooking checklists. You can change [b]R[/b] to any other key binding by using mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

If you press R [b]when using the workbench or stove[/b], the inventories from your bag + connected fridges/chests will be shown on the checklist. In this scenario, the checklist cannot be switched between crafting and cooking pages.

[b][size=5]Potential Mod Conflicts
[/size][/b]This mod may conflict with mods that
[list]
[*]Change the recipe menu and its display during the stove/workbench opening
[*]Change the fridge/chest item display
[*]Change the bag item display
[/list]
[size=5][b]Bug Report?[/b][/size]
Please create a new post describing the issue in detail. A picture would be very helpful!
After the bug is solved, it will be marked with "Bug #?".

[size=5][b]Long-Term Goal[/b][/size]
SVE support

[b][size=5]Special Thanks[/size][/b]
Special thanks to bug/feature reports from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/223268823]kyokutan00[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2737054]dreamingspire[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/448943]halfrobo[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80567108]akitsu2000[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/226288143]PhilmAt11[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url]


[size=5][b]更新日志 (v1.2.0)
[/b][/size]- 修复箱子/背包中的”任意“类别的物品没有被正确计算的bug（例如太阳鱼应当同时被算作”鱼（任意）“）
- 添加法语翻译（感谢[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url]）

[size=5][b]备用下载[/b][/size]
[url=https://github.com/linfanqian/CraftCookTracker/releases]GitHub下载[/url] (CraftCookTracker-[版本].zip)
[url=https://pan.baidu.com/s/11ywD1p2iS8mlqM1Jv1hyAw?pwd=23h3]百度云下载[/url]

[b][size=5]安装[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装SMAPI
[*]将mod文件解压到Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]用SMAPI运行星露谷
[/list][b][size=5]使用方法[/size][/b]
鼠标滑过灶台菜肴或工作台工具制造配方时，可以在物品描述下查看已烹饪/制造了多少件。

按[b]R[/b]查看未制造的工具/未烹饪的菜肴，以及所需材料列表。按[b]←[/b]或[b]→[/b]切换两个列表。你可以通过模组[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]将[b]R[/b]换成其他的键位绑定。

当你在[b]使用工作台或是灶台的时候[/b]按R，背包+连着的冰箱/箱子里的材料会显示在列表里。这种情况下两个列表无法来回切换。

[size=5][b]模组冲突[/b][/size]
此模组可能会与具有下列功能的模组产生冲突：
[list]
[*]更改了灶台/工作台打开时的菜单显示
[*]更改了冰箱/箱子的物品显示
[*]更改了背包的物品显示
[/list]
[b][size=5]Bug报告？[/size][/b]
请添加一个新post，尽可能详细地描述bug。能有图片的话会有很大帮助！
Bug被解决后，会被标注为“Bug #?”。

[size=5][b]长期目标[/b][/size]
支持SVE
